verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama integrates with external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) as a model backend and exposes a REST API, but there is no evidence that Ollama itself acts as an MCP client that can plug in MCP servers to gain access to their tools. Missing for 10: any mention of MCP protocol support, MCP server configuration, or tool-use via MCP within Ollama itself.
